Vision Basics: Wards and the Minimap

Wards let you see enemies coming. Learn the types of wards, how many you can place, and where to put them.

Why vision matters

Most deaths happen because of something you couldn't see: a jungler in the brush, a mid laner walking to your lane. Wards are small items you place on the ground that let your whole team see that area through the fog of war. More vision means fewer surprises.

Trinkets: your free ward

Every champion has a free trinket slot (key 4). There are three trinkets:

  • Stealth Ward: the default. Places an invisible ward, holds up to 2 charges, and recharges over time. Use it all game.
  • Oracle Lens: a sweeper that reveals and disables enemy wards around you for a few seconds. Junglers and supports often switch to it.
  • Farsight Alteration: places a visible ward from very far away. Useful for marksmen later in the game.
Pro tipYour Stealth Ward trinket starts with charges ready. Don't leave them unused. A trinket at full charges is wasted vision.

Control wards

A Control Ward costs 75 gold (40 gold for supports after their quest). It's visible to enemies, but it reveals and disables enemy wards near it, and it stays until someone destroys it.

  • Each player can have 3 Stealth Wards and 1 Control Ward on the map at once.
  • You can carry up to 2 Control Wards in your inventory.

Buy one almost every time you recall. It's one of the best-value items in the game.

Common mistakeNever buying Control Wards because they "don't give stats". 75 gold to spot the enemy jungler before they gank you is worth more than any stat.

Where to ward as a laner

Ward the paths the enemy jungler uses to reach your lane:

  • Top and bot: the river brush (the tri-brush or river entrance) on the side the jungler would come from.
  • Mid: the brushes on either side of the lane, or the river near them. Mid can be ganked from both sides, so ward the side where the enemy jungler was last seen.

Place your first ward around 2:30 to 3:00. That's when junglers finish their first round of camps and look for their first gank.

Wards placed on Faelights (glowing spots in the river and jungle) get extra vision range, so use them when they cover the area you need.

Look at the minimap

Wards are useless if you never look at what they show. The minimap in the corner shows every enemy your team can see. Build the habit of glancing at it every few seconds, for example every time you last-hit a minion.

When an enemy appears on the minimap near your lane, back off. When an enemy laner disappears from their lane, they might be coming for you. See Staying Alive: Map Awareness for Beginners.

Key takeaways

  • Wards let your whole team see through the fog of war.
  • Use your free trinket every time it has a charge.
  • Buy a Control Ward on most recalls; you can have 1 placed and 3 Stealth Wards.
  • As a laner, ward the river path the enemy jungler uses, starting around 2:30-3:00.
  • Glance at the minimap every few seconds.
